profile_text.body:
Atlassian is a publicly traded Australian software company, founded in 2002 and headquartered in Sydney, that develops collaboration and project management tools for software, IT, and business teams. Its core products include Jira, Confluence, Trello, and Loom, which the company describes as forming a connected platform for planning, tracking, and delivering work. Atlassian trades on the Nasdaq under the ticker TEAM and reported revenue of approximately $5.215 billion for the fiscal year ending June 30, 2025, according to its 10-K filing.

On the AI side, Atlassian offers Confluence AI, a team wiki product incorporating smart links, automation, and governance features for Atlassian Cloud, and Trello AI, which brings workflow automation and AI capabilities to its project management tool. The company also promotes Rovo AI agents as part of its broader platform offering. Both AI products are governed under the Atlassian Cloud framework, and the company describes its platform as designed to support evolving regulatory and compliance standards.
